result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where text elements overlap on a restaurant card, making it unreadable.

issues.description: The text elements on the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card are overlapping each other. Specifically, the delivery time estimate and the delivery cost text are rendered on top of one another, making the information illegible.
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout (e.g., using flexbox or grid with appropriate gaps) to ensure text elements are positioned side-by-side or vertically without overlapping.
